extraTabs.about: Public 16" PVC (C900 DR18) water main, about 1,100 ft, in easement on the west side of Green Bay Road (STH 31), connecting to the existing 16" main at 108th Street. Parcel owner (CSM, contract): TI Investors of Lakeview Nitto Parcel LLC. DA party: TI Investors of Pleasant Prairie Holding Company LLC, covering the Nitto parcel and two other properties. The Development Agreement requires financial security for this work, sized from the signed construction contract. Getting the job bid and under contract is the critical path.

approval.title: Approval path, from plan approval to acceptance
approval.lede: The Village sizes the financial security at 120% of the public improvements, inspections and construction-related services, from the signed contract and Pinnacle's construction management estimate (DA Article VI, Ordinance s.395-17; conditions 6 and 7). The DA, Memorandum of DA and Stormwater Maintenance Agreement are signed at closing and recorded before any permits for the watermain (conditions 8 and 9). The Village schedules the preconstruction meeting once all documents and permits are in (condition 11). Dates for bidding, contract, closing and construction are not set yet.
